# Cold Case Christianity

> A Christian apologetics platform using detective methodology and cold case investigation techniques to examine biblical evidence and defend Christian faith.

Cold Case Christianity is built around J. Warner Wallace, a former homicide detective who applies forensic investigation principles to Christian apologetics. The site offers books, curricula, and resources for adults and children exploring Jesus's historicity, God's existence, and faith-based case-making.

## Key Topics

- J. Warner Wallace
- Christian apologetics
- Cold case detective methodology
- Jesus historicity
- Resurrection evidence
- Evidence-based theology
- Forensic Faith
- Case-making
- New Testament
- Detective methodology
- Bible
- Video curriculum
- Children's apologetics
- Small group resources
- God's existence

## About J. Warner Wallace

- [About J. Warner Wallace - Cold Case Christianity](https://coldcasechristianity.com/j-warner-wallace-christian-apologist-and-author): Biography of J. Warner Wallace, cold case detective and Christian apologist

## Books & Publications

- [Books by J. Warner Wallace - Cold Case Christianity](https://coldcasechristianity.com/books-by-j-warner-wallace): Catalog of J. Warner Wallace's books on Christian apologetics and true crime
- [Cold-Case Christianity 10th Anniversary Edition](https://coldcasechristianity.com/cold-case-christianity-10th-anniversary): 10th anniversary edition of flagship 'Cold-Case Christianity' book
- [Person of Interest by J. Warner Wallace](https://coldcasechristianity.com/person-of-interest-by-j-warner-wallace): Product page for 'Person of Interest' examining Jesus's historicity
- [God's Crime Scene by J. Warner Wallace](https://coldcasechristianity.com/gods-crime-scene-by-j-warner-wallace): Product page for 'God's Crime Scene' examining God's existence
- [Forensic Faith by J. Warner Wallace](https://coldcasechristianity.com/forensic-faith-by-j-warner-wallace): Product page for 'Forensic Faith' on case-making and evidential faith
- [The Truth in True Crime](https://coldcasechristianity.com/the-truth-in-true-crime): Product page for 'The Truth in True Crime' book and video curriculum
- [Case Closed: A Detective Investigates the Resurrection](https://coldcasechristianity.com/case-closed): Evangelism booklet examining resurrection evidence using detective methods
- [So the Next Generation Will Know by Sean McDowell and J. Warner Wallace](https://coldcasechristianity.com/books-by-j-warner-wallace/so-the-next-generation-will-know-by-sean-mcdowell-and-j-warner-wallace): Co-authored book on Christian worldview for Generation Z and parents

## Children's Books

- [Cold-Case Christianity for Kids by J. Warner and Susie Wallace](https://coldcasechristianity.com/cold-case-christianity-for-kids-by-j-warner-and-susie-wallace): Children's version of Cold-Case Christianity by Wallace and wife Susie
- [God's Crime Scene for Kids by J. Warner and Susie Wallace](https://coldcasechristianity.com/gods-crime-scene-for-kids-by-j-warner-and-susie-wallace): Children's version of 'God's Crime Scene' for ages 8-12
- [Forensic Faith for Kids by J. Warner and Susie Wallace](https://coldcasechristianity.com/forensic-faith-for-kids-by-j-warner-and-susie-wallace): Children's version of 'Forensic Faith' teaching critical thinking

## Articles & Essays

- [Do Christian Apologetics Efforts Have Any Value?](https://coldcasechristianity.com/writings/do-christian-apologetics-efforts-have-any-value): Article examining the value and biblical basis of Christian apologetics
- [Was Jesus Just a Magician?](https://coldcasechristianity.com/writings/was-jesus-just-a-magician): Apologetics article examining Jesus's miracles versus magic claims
- [What Is Christian Discipleship?](https://coldcasechristianity.com/writings/what-is-christian-discipleship): Article defining Christian discipleship and spiritual mentoring
- [Should Christians Judge Others?](https://coldcasechristianity.com/writings/should-christians-judge-others): Article addressing biblical interpretation of Christian judgment and ethics
